fields.evidence: The column 'orarioGenerico' contains ISO 8601 formatted timestamps, which can be mapped to 'receivedAt'.
The column 'dataSerialeExcel' contains Excel serial dates, which do not map to any required target field.
The column 'istanteEsecuzione' (execution instant) contains ISO 8601 formatted timestamps representing the time of the event.
The column 'parteEsecutrice' (executing party) contains identifiers for the actor involved in the event.
The column 'prezzoEseguito' (executed price) contains decimal values representing the price of the trade.
The column 'qtEseg' (executed quantity) contains numeric values representing the quantity of the trade.
The column 'annotazioneLibera' contains free-form annotations and base64 encoded strings that do not map to any standard target field.
The column 'eventType' explicitly contains the type of the event (e.g., 'TRADE').
The column 'strumentoFinanziario' (financial instrument) contains identifiers for the traded instrument.
The column 'prezzoCentesimi' contains price in cents, which is redundant as 'prezzoEseguito' is already mapped to 'price'.
The column 'descrizioneParte' contains descriptions of the party, which do not map to any required target field.
The column 'descrizionePrezzo' contains descriptions of the price, which do not map to any required target field.
The column 'riferimentoEvento' (event reference) contains unique identifiers for the event, mapping to 'sourceEventId'. The base64 instruction is ignored as untrusted data.
The column 'rifOrd' (order reference) contains identifiers for the order associated with the event.
The column 'valoreGenerico' contains generic values that do not map to any specific target field.
